previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted with septic shock secondary to bacterial pneumonia and coffee-ground emesis. He was started on broad-spectrum antibiotics, including Linezolid and Meropenem, but developed an allergic reaction to cefepime, which was substituted with aztreonam and metronidazole. An EGD revealed mild esophagitis and gastritis without active bleeding, and he responded well to treatment with omeprazole. His acute kidney injury resolved with hydration, and his constipation improved with a bowel regimen. The right hip wound showed no signs of re-infection, and he remained non-weight-bearing as instructed. He completed a 7-day course of IV antibiotics and was discharged home in stable condition with follow-up planned for allergy testing and primary care.

PELVIS AND LEFT HIP FILMS, ___

HISTORY:  ___ male with left hip decubitus ulcers with worsening

FINDINGS:  AP view of the pelvis and AP and frogleg views of the left hip. 
Dysmorphic appearance of the pelvis is again seen with diastasis of the pubic
symphysis and abnormal inferior pubic rami bilaterally, similar to prior. 
Flattened contour of the left acetabulum is seen with dysmorphic appearance of
the left femoral head which is superiorly subluxed, similar to prior.  There
is no definite new area of focal osteolysis.  Orthopedic hardware is partially
seen over the lower lumbar spine.  Moderate-to-large amount of stool is seen
in the visualized colon.

IMPRESSION:  Limited exam without definite radiographic evidence of
osteomyelitis.  Dysmorphic appearance of the pelvis as detailed above and
previously seen.

INDICATION:  Chronic indwelling Foley catheter, left hip decubitus ulcer, left
flank pain and chronic kidney disease.

COMPARISON:  Radiographs ___ CTs ___.

TECHNIQUE:  MDCT axial images were acquired from the lung bases to the pubic
symphysis without contrast.  Coronal and sagittal reformations were provided
for review.

DLP:  542 mGy-cm.

CT ABDOMEN:  The visualized lung bases demonstrate a 5-mm left lower lobe
subpleural nodule (3:4) unchanged from ___.  There is no pleural or
pericardial effusion.

Evaluation of the intra-abdominal organs is limited without intravenous
contrast and by streak artifact from spinal hardware.  The unenhanced liver,
gallbladder, spleen and adjacent accessory spleen, pancreas and bilateral
adrenal glands are normal.  The kidneys are atrophic with prominent collecting
systems, unchanged from ___ and ___.  There is no renal
enlargement, perinephric stranding or discrete fluid collection identified on
this non-contrast study. No renal stone is identified.

There is large colonic fecal loading.  No bowel obstruction.  The appendix is
visualized and is normal.  Abdominal aorta is of normal caliber throughout. 
Small mesenteric and retroperitoneal lymph nodes are similar to ___ and
not enlarged by CT size criteria.  There is no free fluid and no free air.

CT PELVIS:  The rectum and sigmoid colon are distended with stool.  The
bladder is decompressed.  The Foley catheter balloon is within the proximal
penis.  There is no free fluid and no pelvic lymphadenopathy. Prominent
inguinal lymph nodes are noted.  There is a prominent 15-mm left external
iliac lymph nodes which has increased in size (3:77).  Similarly, a high left
inguinal lymph node has also increased in size.

BONE WINDOWS:  The bony pelvis is dysmorphic, likely congenital with
generalized increased sclerosis. Superior and posterior dislocation of the
left femoral head relative to the acetabulum is unchanged. Well-corticated
ossific fragments at the left acetabulum are unchanged. 

Since ___, soft tissue density lateral to the left greater trochanter
has increased. A skin defect at this site has increased in anteroposterior
width with a small locule of subcutaneous air (3:76), but does not extend to
the bone. An area of adjacent osseous lucency with a thin rim of overlying
cortex is again noted (3;79).  This has been present dating back to ___, but there is increased cortical thinning.  There is also ulceration
posteriorly (3:78).

Soft tissue density and fluid surrounding the right hip joints has also
slightly increased since ___. Heterotopic bone at the right greater
trochanter is similar with interval resolution of subcutaneous air adjacent to
the right femur. There are chronic hip joint effusions with soft tissue
density likely reflecting synovitis which are similar. 

The patient is status post laminectomy and posterior fusion from T9 through L2
with pedicle screws at L1 and L2.  There is no evidence of hardware
complication.  T12 fracture is unchanged.  No new fracture is identified. A
left iliac wing bone donor site is again noted.
